input.command:
git push -u origin ui-polish-and-session-missing 2>&1 | tail -3 && gh pr create --title "iOS: working indicator, one-tap Tab, selection-safe swipes, wrapped links; bridge: honest missing-session transcripts" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Bridge: report missing session files (`fix(bridge)`)

When a surface's `checkpoint_id` named a deleted session `.jsonl`, the resolver fell back to the newest file in the cwd's project dir — with several surfaces sharing a cwd, the history viewer showed a *different* surface's conversation. The resolver now stops instead of falling back, `claude.transcript` returns `session_missing`, and the iOS viewer says the file is gone rather than presenting someone else's history.

## iOS: four quality-of-life fixes (`feat(ios)`)

- **Working indicator**: pane cards show pulsing dots while a surface is actively producing output. No busy state exists in the protocol, so it's derived from "the last `read_text` poll saw the screen change" (TUIs repaint while running, go static when idle). Focus-driven read-depth flips don't count as activity, and sends schedule a 1.5s probe so the indicator reacts quickly even for background tiles on the ~15s poll.
- **One-tap Tab**: the collapsed input bar now carries an always-visible `⇥` chip — previously Tab required raising the keyboard or the long-press quick-action popup.
- **Selection-safe swipes**: the terminal text view reports select/deselect transitions and the surface-cycle swipe vetoes itself while a selection is active, so dragging to select text no longer flips surfaces. While text is selected, swipes stay disabled until deselect (by design).
- **Wrapped-link joining**: a URL hard-wrapped by the terminal (`…business_os_landscap` / `e.html`) is re-joined into a single tappable link spanning the visual break; previously only the first fragment was linkified and 404'd. Join requires the match to run to the edge of a full-width row (longest row in the snapshot, ≥40 cols) with URL characters continuing the next row, so ordinary prose can't false-join.

## Testing

- `go test ./...` in `bridge/` — all pass (includes new `transcript_test.go` cases for the missing-session paths).
- `xcodebuild -target cmux -sdk iphonesimulator26.5` — build succeeded.
- Link-joining logic verified offline against the reported URL, a three-row wrap, and three no-false-positive cases.
- Manually exercised on-device against a live bridge (indicator, Tab, selection vs. swipe, tappable joined links).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)"

Done — **PR #21**: https://github.com/itsmaleen/cmux-companion/pull/21

Three commits on `ui-polish-and-session-missing`:

1. `fix(bridge)` — the session-missing transcript work (bridge files + the matching `claudeTranscriptMissing` hunks split out of `AppState.swift`/`PaneCardView.swift`)
2. `feat(ios)` — the four fixes from yesterday (working indicator, one-tap Tab, selection-safe swipes, wrapped-link joining)
3. `chore` — the stray `.entire/.gitignore` line, kept separate so it doesn't muddy either changeset

Working tree is clean, Go tests and the iOS build were green before pushing, and the PR body notes your on-device confirmation.
